weather.seasonHint: Season: is the irrigation season active? In "Winter" (off-season), all runs are skipped.

history.title: History
history.deleteAllMessage: The entire watering history will be permanently deleted. Settings and plans are kept.
history.deleteOldMessage: All history entries older than 30 days will be permanently deleted. Settings and plans are kept.

help.basisC: Reference temperature at which watering runs at 100%. Above it watering scales up, below it scales down.
help.pctPerC: How many percent the watering duration changes per degree away from the reference temperature.
help.minPct: Lower bound of the temperature factor — watering never drops below this percentage.
help.maxPct: Upper bound of the temperature factor — watering never exceeds this percentage.
help.thresholdProb: Minimum rain probability before a rain forecast reduces watering at all.
help.reduceAbove: Forecast rainfall (mm) above which watering starts to be reduced.
help.zeroAbove: Forecast rainfall (mm) at or above which watering is skipped entirely.
help.forecastDecay: Weighting (0–1) of tomorrow's rain relative to today's. 1 = counts fully, 0 = ignored.

config.mqttEnabledHint: Publish liters & run durations to Home Assistant as sensors

sensorHelp.rain: Required. Binary sensor detecting rain. When "on", a running watering is aborted immediately.
sensorHelp.wind: Optional. Binary sensor for wind alert. When "on", sequences with "wind blocks" are skipped.
sensorHelp.season: Optional. Binary sensor for the irrigation season. When "off", all runs are skipped (winter pause).
sensorHelp.temperature: Required. Current outdoor temperature in °C. Basis for the temperature factor.
sensorHelp.temperature_max: Optional. Forecast daily max temperature in °C. Preferred over current temperature when available.
sensorHelp.precipitation_prob_today: Optional. Rain probability today (0–100 %). Feeds into the rain factor.
sensorHelp.precipitation_prob_tomorrow: Optional. Rain probability tomorrow (0–100 %). Feeds into the rain factor.
sensorHelp.precipitation_today: Optional. Expected precipitation today in mm. Together with the threshold determines the reduction.
sensorHelp.precipitation_tomorrow: Optional. Expected precipitation tomorrow in mm. Weighted by the forecast decay factor.
